subject: infra.energy
name: National policy linking digital infrastructure to energy supply
what_would_settle_it: A national policy or programme document connecting grid rehabilitation or generation capacity to digital-infrastructure planning.

subject: infra.capacity
name: Compute or high-performance computing capacity
what_would_settle_it: A data-centre, cloud or high-performance computing specification, or a hosting contract for a public system beyond the two named data centres.

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A public-sector open-data portal or policy document.

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation with Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any EU or European Investment Bank digital financing, programme or memorandum covering Sudan.

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital-sector engagement with Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any Indian government or vendor financing, contract or memorandum covering Sudanese digital infrastructure.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Fiscal-year budget for the digital estate
what_would_settle_it: Sudan's enacted budget for 2025 or 2026, read into budgets/SDN/ with the digital lines of the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, the digital authorities, the civil registry and the central bank's payment systems.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Where the offshore backup of the vehicle and driving-licence database is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A traffic police or Ministry of Interior statement naming the country and provider hosting the offshore backup and the terms governing it.
